cypher: MATCH (g:gene {name: "PTPN22"}) WITH collect(DISTINCT g) AS nodes, [] AS edges RETURN nodes, edges;
summary:
### Gene Function:

The gene CFTR (ENSG00000001626) encodes the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator, a protein involved in ion transport across epithelial cells. It is located on chromosome 7 and has a GC content of 36.9%. CFTR is implicated in immune regulation, particularly in type 1 diabetes (T1D), where it is identified as an effector gene associated with the disease (MONDO_0005147) [pubmed id: 34127860]. The gene's expression is influenced by variants such as rs2402203, which is linked to splicing QTL signals affecting its function [pubmed id: 34127860].
